verdict.rationale: Paying international contractors is a fair axis for a payroll product, but the evidence only documents domestic contractor payments by direct deposit, check, or historical record. Nothing shows local-currency payouts, international contractor support or compliant contracts. A community report that Gusto "doesn't support outside of US folks" also points toward no support, and there is no vendor claim for it to dispute.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay international contractors in their local currencies with compliant contracts
